about: Ask Gedara accuracy set (Phase 10). Each question's truth is SQL written by hand on the raw tables (never the ask_* functions), run read-only on prod. :T = today (Asia/Colombo), :H = the household. `pick` is the path in the answer of call 0 that must equal the truth. A refusal question expects that refusal and no calls. Plans come from the staging ask-gedara function (the AI sees only the question), so prod data never reaches an AI. Questions with "set": "held" were written after the first tuning round and are never used to tune the prompt or the functions: they show how Ask does on questions it wasn't tuned for.
spend: select coalesce(sum(case when t.type = 'refund' then -l.amount else l.amount end), 0) from transaction_line l join money_transaction t on t.id = l.transaction_id and t.household_id = l.household_id left join category c on c.id = l.category_id where t.household_id = :H and t.type in ('expense', 'refund')

questions.q: How much did we spend on vegetables since June?
questions.truth: {spend} and c.name = 'Vegetables' and t.occurred_on between '2026-06-01' and :T

questions.q: How much did we spend on petrol in October?
questions.truth: {spend} and c.name = 'Petrol' and t.occurred_on between '2026-10-01' and '2026-10-31'

questions.q: What did we spend on dining out last month?
questions.truth: {spend} and (c.name = 'Dining out' or c.parent_id = (select id from category where household_id = :H and name = 'Dining out' and parent_id is null)) and t.occurred_on between '2026-10-01' and '2026-10-31'

questions.q: How much did we spend at Cargills since July?
questions.truth: {spend} and coalesce((select m.name from merchant m where m.id = t.merchant_id), t.payee_text) ilike '%cargills%' and t.occurred_on between '2026-07-01' and :T

questions.truth: {spend} and coalesce((select m.name from merchant m where m.id = t.merchant_id), t.payee_text) ilike '%keells%' and t.occurred_on between date_trunc('month', :T::date)::date and :T

questions.q: Spending by category in September
questions.truth: {spend} and t.occurred_on between '2026-09-01' and '2026-09-30'

questions.q: Which shop did we spend the most at in October?
questions.truth: select x.n from (select coalesce(m.name, t.payee_text) n, sum(case when t.type = 'refund' then -l.amount else l.amount end) s from transaction_line l join money_transaction t on t.id = l.transaction_id left join merchant m on m.id = t.merchant_id where t.household_id = :H and t.type in ('expense', 'refund') and t.occurred_on between '2026-10-01' and '2026-10-31' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 1) x

questions.q: How much did we spend in the last week?
questions.truth: {spend} and t.occurred_on between :T::date - 7 and :T

questions.q: How much did we spend on clothes this year?
questions.truth: {spend} and c.name = 'Clothing' and t.occurred_on between '2026-01-01' and :T

questions.q: Show the last 3 petrol bills
questions.truth: select max(t.occurred_on)::text from transaction_line l join money_transaction t on t.id = l.transaction_id join category c on c.id = l.category_id where t.household_id = :H and t.type = 'expense' and c.name = 'Petrol' and t.occurred_on <= :T

questions.q: When did we last pay the water bill?

questions.q: What's due this month?
questions.truth: select coalesce(sum(p.monthly), 0) from instalment_plan p cross join generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where p.household_id = :H and not p.archived and (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date between :T and (date_trunc('month', :T::date) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date

questions.q: What do we have to pay in December?
questions.truth: select coalesce(sum(p.monthly), 0) from instalment_plan p cross join generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where p.household_id = :H and not p.archived and (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date between '2026-12-01' and '2026-12-31'

questions.q: How much are the instalments in January?
questions.truth: select coalesce(sum(p.monthly), 0) from instalment_plan p cross join generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where p.household_id = :H and not p.archived and (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date between '2027-01-01' and '2027-01-31'

questions.q: When does the Toyota instalment end?
questions.truth: select (first_on + make_interval(months => total_count - 1))::date::text from instalment_plan where household_id = :H and name = 'Toyota Lanka'

questions.q: How much is left to pay on the Luxury X plan?
questions.truth: select round((p.total_count - (select count(*) from generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date <= :T)) * p.monthly, 2) from instalment_plan p where p.household_id = :H and p.name = 'Luxury X'

questions.q: How much do we still owe on the BOC loan?
questions.truth: select round(p.principal * power(1 + p.annual_rate / 1200, k.paid) - p.monthly * (power(1 + p.annual_rate / 1200, k.paid) - 1) / (p.annual_rate / 1200), 2) from instalment_plan p cross join lateral (select count(*)::int paid from generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date <= :T) k where p.household_id = :H and p.name = 'BOC Loan'

questions.q: How many insurance instalments are left?
questions.truth: select p.total_count - (select count(*) from generate_series(1, p.total_count) n where (p.first_on + make_interval(months => n - 1))::date <= :T) from instalment_plan p where p.household_id = :H and p.name = 'Sri Lanka Insurance'
